title: Click-Clack Cuttlefish
statement: Hovering amid swaying bioluminescent kelp, this endlessly curious cephalopod collects bits of sunken sea glass, rhythmically clicking them together to build intricate, ever-changing mosaics on the dark sand. Whenever a pattern feels complete, ripples of warm amber and twilight indigo cascade across its skin before it happily scrambles the pieces to begin anew.
